calibration_domain: This controlled analytical calibration accepts only records with RDKit CalcNumHBAin[2,3],CalcNumHBD<=2and CalcTPSAin[25,60]angstrom². Limits are inclusive. These are named graph descriptors,not counts of hetero atoms or donor hydrogens and not the distinct CalcNumLipinskiHBA/HBDdefinitions.
selection: Among eligible records choose every minimum average molar-mass candidate. Do not trade a failed descriptor constraint against a lower mass. No measured solubility,binding,permeability or biological activity is claimed.
